thread:
jess_support: Customer ACME Feed Co flagged invoice INV-2026-3375 — sales tax was charged even though PO indicates reseller exemption and ship-to is a 3rd-party warehouse in OH. PO# 45012. They attached a resale certificate in the ticket.
omar_billing: Can you paste the invoice id + the tax calc response? What shipping address did our system use?
jess_support: INV-2026-3375
Invoice summary from UI: total: $2,135.00, tax_amount: $128.50, tax_jurisdiction: OH, rate: 6.75%
Billing addr (entity): 200 Market St, San Francisco, CA (reseller entity)
Ship-to (on PO): 123 Warehouse Rd, Columbus, OH 43215 (3rd-party warehouse)
Customer claims they're resale-exempt for resale to end customers; reseller cert uploaded (see ticket).
omar_billing: Quick check — our tax service defaults to shipping address jurisdiction unless there's an override. But reseller exemptions should override if the billing entity has a valid certificate on file. Can you include the raw tax call payload (redact PII)?
jess_support: Pasting snippet from logs (redacted):
```
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-3375",
  "billing_entity_id": "ENT-9987",
  "ship_to_state": "OH",
  "billing_state": "CA",
  "resale_certificate_on_file": true,
  "tax_service_response": {"jurisdiction": "OH", "tax_due": 128.50, "rate": 0.0675}
}
```
So looks like our tax service returned OH tax even though `resale_certificate_on_file` is true.
sophie_tax: Adding context: US sales tax depends on seller nexus, destination sourcing rules, and valid exemption docs tied to the billed entity. If the seller (us) doesn't have nexus in OH, we shouldn't be collecting OH tax — unless customer provided a certificate only for CA? Do we have the cert metadata stored and scoped to the billing entity?
raj_engineer: I tried to reproduce in staging. Steps: 1) Create customer with billing_entity_id ENT-9987 and `resale_exempt: true` 2) Create order with ship_to_state OH 3) Post invoice -> tax service returns OH tax. Repro is consistent. It looks like the exemption flag is present in the invoice object but we are not forwarding it to the `calculateTax` microservice — payload missing `exemptions` field. I'll open a PR to include `resale_certificate: true` in the call.
maria_finance: Immediate mitigation: issue a credit note for the tax portion and reissue a corrected invoice (zero tax). We need the reseller certificate attached to the billing entity in our system to justify the credit. The customer attached it in the support ticket — can someone confirm it's been uploaded to the account?
jess_support: Confirmed: certificate PDF uploaded to ticket and linked to ENT-9987 (`file_7862`). I will attach to account record now.
maria_finance: OK drafting credit note CN-2026-112 for $128.50, reason: "tax adjustment - reseller certificate applied". Will mark as non-chargeback. ETA 2 business days.
billing-bot: Credit note CN-2026-112 created for INV-2026-3375 by maria_finance.
omar_billing: @raj_engineer please add a regression test and a telemetry metric for cases where `tax_service_response.jurisdiction != billing_state` while `resale_certificate_on_file == true`. We should also emit an audit event when exemption is not honored.
raj_engineer: Got it — adding unit/regression tests and an integration test for `calculateTax` payload. Will also add logs for `exemption_forwarded: true/false`. Target PR today.
jess_support: I'll reply to the customer: apologise, confirm credit being issued, and that we will reissue the corrected invoice once credit posts. Also ask them to confirm the uploaded certificate is the final one.
maria_finance: Note for ops: if more invoices affected, we'll batch credits when same billing entity and time window.
sophie_tax: After fix, run a sample of last 30 days for customers with reseller flags and ship_to_state != billing_state to ensure no other misapplies.
jess_support: Thanks all :thumbsup:
